rules.D1_CLOSE_WEAK_2P5: If D1 close <= entry_open * 0.975, hypothetical exit at D2 open
rules.D3_NO_REBOUND_4P0: If D3 close <= entry_open * 0.96 AND max(D1..D3 high) < entry_open * 1.05, hypothetical exit at D4 open
rules.COMBINED_EARLIEST: earliest of D1 or D3; else D30 close

volume_warning_only: D1..D3 at least two red bars; D3 amount >= 1.5 * mean(D1,D2 amount); D3 close below entry. No exit rule.
known_limitations: Retrospective 59 events; exploratory criteria not OOS
Next-day open is hypothetical, no fill/latency/limits
unadjusted price PIT and corporate actions not certified
single start day baseline entry used; no scale/portfolio/cost of idle capital
